description: DEALS (buyer): check a delivered step against the seller's signed fingerprint. Free (no transaction). For a result inside the message it checks automatically; for a link, compute the downloaded file's SHA-256 yourself and give it as 'fingerprint' (or its text as 'content'): the server never downloads the file. A NO MATCH blocks your next deal_pay until a check gives MATCH. Returns {ok, match, verdict, fingerprint_sha256, txid, seller_signer}. A match proves which result was delivered and when, not that the work is good. Needs the header 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' (your wallet key from create_wallet).

content.description: Optional: the text you received, to fingerprint

fingerprint.description: Optional: SHA-256 of the file you downloaded

step.description: Step to check (default: the latest delivered)

name: deal_check
